  • Partner with clients to assess business needs and define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  • Lead project planning, execution, and governance, ensuring timelines, KPIs, and quality standards are met.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by proactively understanding client environments and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Coordinate with Product, Sales, and internal teams to ensure seamless implementation, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct workshops, manage stakeholder communication, and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Share best practices, deliver internal training, and contribute to process optimization within Professional Services.
  • Drive customer success by fostering adoption, monitoring health metrics, and identifying upsell opportunities.
  • Gather client feedback to inform product development and enhance the overall customer experience.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience in payments, fraud, risk management or ecommerce industry.
  • 5+ years of client-facing experience, with a strong focus on risk mitigation strategies.
  • Proven track record in account management, client delivery, and complex project implementations.
  • Strong consultative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in statistics and data forensics.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships and drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Experienced in cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, and sales teams.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset, high integrity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Working for you

  • Hybrid work system

  • Health and dental plans
  • RECARES days for supporting charity

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos | Benefícios
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.


Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.


Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Garantir cumprimento dos SLAs internos e prazos das operadoras e fornecedores, conforme contrato;
  • Manter base de dados de beneficiários sempre atualizada e auditada;
  • Gerenciar exceções de Assistência Médica;
  • Atuar como ponto focal junto às operadoras de saúde, odontologia e outros fornecedores;
  • Acompanhar relatórios de utilização, absenteísmo e sinistralidade;
  • Atender colaboradores para esclarecimento de dúvidas sobre cobertura, reembolso, carência e rede credenciada;
  • Apoiar casos sensíveis (ex.: internações, procedimentos de alto custo, negativa de cobertura);
  • Elaborar KPIs mensais: tempo médio de movimentação, índice de erros, custo por colaborador, utilização de plano;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas.• Garantir confidencialidade e compliance na gestão de dados de saúde;
  • Mapear oportunidades de melhoria de processos.• Implantar automações ou integrações junto aos fornecedores;
  • Propor ações de educação em saúde (ex.: campanhas preventivas, odontologia preventiva, check-ups e outros).


Principais Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Pacote Office avançado (principalmente Excel - fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards).Sistemas de folha de pagamento e gestão de RH (ex.: ADP, SAP, Senior, TOTVS);
  • Sistemas de benefícios (integrações com operadoras, plataformas de gestão de benefícios flexíveis);

Sobre a Oportunidade

  • Remuneração compatível com experiência e perfil técnico.


Sobre a Navigandi

A Navigandi , fundada em 2019 como spin-off do Laboratório Tanque de Provas Numérico da USP (TPN-USP), é uma empresa especializada no desenvolvimento de tecnologias e equipamentos de auxílio à navegação .


Entre suas inovações está o Navigandi Orbis , a primeira Portable Pilot Unit (PPU) totalmente desenvolvida nas Américas, amplamente utilizada por práticos em diversos portos brasileiros. Também desenvolveu o Navigandi Tow , sistema de navegação para empurradores e comboios fluviais.


Com forte foco em P&D , parcerias com a FAPESP e a USP , a empresa se dedica a criar soluções que promovam segurança, eficiência e inovação na navegação aquaviária .

title: Especialista em Processos e Dados (Commercial Flows)
description:
Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), established in 1851, is a leading global merchant and processor of agricultural goods (also called commodity trading) with more than 22 000 employees worldwide. LDC reported in 2014, the Group started to rotate to Process harmonization, Global Organizations and especially Digitalization by opening a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Finance, IT and HR based in Lyon.


Together with the CoE, the LDC Groups created a Global Finance Team, called FPSO (for Finance Processes Systems and Organization), which is reporting directly to the Group CFO and for which the aim is to:

  • Lead the Finance Transformation of the group
  • Digitalize LDC Processes and organizations
  • Help LDC to rotate to Finance best practices and best tools


In 2018, the Group materialized its ambition by initiated a Global Finance Transformation and Digitilization of its Back Office operations (Accounting, Controlling, Reporting, Procurement). It consists into a:

  • Reshaping of accounting and controlling processes
  • The implementation of SAP S/4 HANA suite including Business Intelligence, ARIBA


As of 2025, implementations have been done in several regions, including countries such as Argentina, Suisse, US, China. The program roadmap ends around 2028 and will be followed by other transformations project on other systems.


The FPSO team consist into an international team of experiences resources with strong expertise in there domain. They act as the keeper of the Group practices and solutions. They coordinate the different on-going project in the LDC world for their respective scope.


Main Responsibilities

The FPSO team is looking for FPSO Specialist Commercial Flows, who will be in charge of the one or more of the below E2E processes flows:

  • Purchase and Sales of commercial goods
  • Inventory management
  • Transportation flows

title: Finance Lead
description:
Our client is building a women’s longevity platform - science-backed products and daily rituals that help millions feel younger, longer. They are growing quickly and hiring their first end-to-end finance leader to own FP&A, investor reporting, and the accounting/controller function.


Role

Own the finance stack end-to-end: FP&A, Investor Relations, and Controllership . Close the books, produce decision-grade insights, and allocate capital toward the highest ROI/ROIC uses.


Responsibilities


Financial Planning and Analysis

  • Build and maintain the operating model (budget, rolling forecast, scenarios).
  • Analyze unit economics (AOV, GM%, CAC/LTV, payback, retention cohorts) and convert insights into actions.
  • Drive capital allocation: prepare ROI/ROIC cases for SKU, channel, inventory, and marketing investments; recommend go/no-go.
  • Publish a concise monthly KPI pack with variance analysis and clear owners for corrective actions.


Accounting & Controllership

  • Run the monthly close with external accounting firm; deliver P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow on a fixed cadence.
  • Produce cash and accrual views with BS→P&L→CF bridges; reconcile statutory vs. management reporting.
  • Own policies and the chart of accounts; ensure clean revenue recognition, COGS/inventory controls, and 3PL, AP/AR, bank reconciliations.
  • Manage compliance/ancillary filings and documentation.


Investor Relations

  • Ship a monthly fund/investor report: KPIs, narrative, drivers, and risks; maintain a current data room.
  • Support fundraising/diligence with cohort/LTV analysis, CAC trends, working capital, and inventory turns; prepare board materials.


Systems

  • Operate in QuickBooks Online and advanced spreadsheets; manage integrations (Shopify/e-commerce, banks, 3PL, AP).
  • Stand up lightweight BI (Looker Studio/Metabase/Sheets) for self-serve reporting.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in FP&A/Controllership, investment banking, management consulting, or finance roles at hypergrowth, venture-backed companies; CPG/e-commerce a plus.
  • Fluent English; strong analytical and verbal/written communication skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills; SQL/BI a plus.


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to US GAAP compliance.


Location: Belo Hortizonte or São Paulo

title: Growth Content Manager (Foco Total em YouTube)
description:
O Growth Content Manager é alguém que resolve o conteúdo como um sistema.


Nesse papel, você vai trabalhar diretamente com o CEO e as lideranças da Cota Real para estruturar, captar, editar e escalar o canal do YouTube como uma máquina de aquisição, autoridade e vendas.

Você não estará apenas fazendo vídeo. Estará criando ativos digitais que posicionam, vendem e escalam nosso negócio.

Se você edita rápido, mas não entende de retenção, essa vaga não é para você.

Se você entende de copy, canal, hook e SEO de YouTube — e ainda sabe captar e editar com padrão de qualidade profissional — então siga lendo.


O que exatamente você vai fazer:

  • Captar vídeos semanalmente com qualidade profissional de luz, áudio e direção
  • Editar vídeos longos (YouTube) com foco em: ritmo, retenção, storytelling e copy visual
  • Produzir Shorts e Reels a partir de vídeos longos com objetivo de gerar tráfego e autoridade
  • Otimizar e publicar os vídeos com foco em CTR, SEO e watch time
  • Criar e manter uma esteira de conteúdo com backlog organizado, estruturado e previsível
  • Trabalhar com títulos e thumbnails estrategicamente, testando formatos com base em dados
  • Analisar a performance dos vídeos e sugerir melhorias com base em retenção, CTR, view velocity
  • Participar da estratégia editorial junto ao CEO e lideranças, alinhando conteúdo com campanhas e produtos

    • Por que essa vaga importa (para você)

    Se você enxerga o YouTube como negócio, não como passatempo — esse cargo é o seu campo de guerra.

    Você será o arquiteto do nosso canal.

    Não para deixá-lo bonito. Mas para fazê-lo vender, crescer e posicionar.

    Aqui, o conteúdo é o ativo.

    E você será o responsável direto por construir esse ativo com consistência e performance.

    Se você quer responsabilidade real, visibilidade direta no negócio e liberdade pra criar com base em resultado, essa é sua vaga.


    Responsabilidades:

    • Captar, dirigir e produzir conteúdo audiovisual com padrão profissional
    • Editar vídeos longos e shorts com foco em performance, e não só estética
    • Garantir que cada vídeo tenha objetivo claro: reter, converter, gerar lead ou fortalecer autoridade
    • Publicar com consistência e SEO bem feito (título, thumbnail, descrição, palavras-chave)
    • Iterar com base nos dados: entender o que funcionou, ajustar, repetir
    • Propor novos formatos, roteiros e quadros com base no que gera resultado
    • Garantir que o canal cresça em inscritos, visualizações e influência com conteúdo de verdade


    Requisitos:

    • Experiência sólida com edição de vídeos para YouTube (mínimo 3 anos)
    • Domínio de Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut Pro ou ferramentas similares
    • Domínio técnico de captação audiovisual: luz, som, câmera, enquadramento
    • Compreensão profunda de YouTube Studio, métricas de retenção, CTR, view velocity
    • Capacidade de transformar uma ideia em vídeo com roteiro, CTA e punch
    • Autonomia para executar sem ser microgerenciado
    • Clareza para comunicar, disciplina para entregar, humildade para melhorar


    Resultados Esperados:

    • Vídeos semanais com retention médio acima de 55%
    • Shorts gerando tráfego e conversão real (não só views)
    • Canal crescendo em inscritos e engajamento mês após mês
    • Backlog de vídeos com 2 a 3 semanas de antecedência
    • Publicações alinhadas com campanhas, funis e objeções estratégicas
    • Canal posicionado como referência em conteúdo de inteligência patrimonial


    Compensação e Crescimento:

    • Remuneração Inicial: R$ 6.000 a R$ 8.000/mês (PJ)
    • Após 6 meses: possibilidade de aumento conforme impacto direto nas métricas do canal
    • Bônus por Performance: atrelado a crescimento de canal, retenção média e consistência de publicações
    • Possibilidade de equity em produtos futuros ou liderança de célula de conteúdo


    Local de Trabalho: Presencial em Balneário Camboriú



    Nossos Valores Fundamentais

    A pessoa certa para este cargo valoriza cada um desses princípios, os adota pessoalmente e entende por que cada um deles é essencial para construir um grande negócio:

    Grandeza Competitiva: Esteja no seu melhor quando o seu melhor for necessário. Enfrente desafios difíceis com entusiasmo, melhore constantemente com inteligência e paciência, e transforme avanços pequenos em grandes resultados ao longo do tempo.

    Caráter Inquestionável: Seja o tipo de pessoa com quem todos querem se associar, pessoal e profissionalmente. Alinhamento genuíno entre pensamento, fala e ação em direção a um objetivo que vale a pena.

    Vá Além: Fazemos o que a concorrência não quer fazer. Atendimento, execução, integridade – mesmo quando dói no curto prazo.

title: Lab Technician
description:
Are you our new Calibration Lab Technician with Maersk H2S Safety Services in Brazil?


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute calibration, functional tests, and adjustments on portable and fixed gas detectors.
  • Carry out Zero and Span adjustment procedures using certified and traceable standard gases.
  • Issue calibration certificates in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Ensure metrological traceability of results and maintain complete records of services performed.
  • Ensure the organization of the laboratory and suggest improvements in the process.
  • Follow the laboratory's calibration methods and procedures.
  • Periodically check the validity and integrity of reference standards.
  • Prepare technical reports and support internal and external audits.
  • Comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations throughout the calibration process.



We are looking for

  • Technical education in Instrumentation, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics and related areas.
  • Previous experience in calibration and maintenance of gas detectors.
  • Knowledge of metrology, traceability, and uncertainty assessment.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025 standards and Cgcre/Inmetro procedures.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals and manufacturer specifications.
  • Proficiency in technical documentation and issuance of calibration certificates.


Skills

  • Attention to detail and focus on accuracy.
  • Organization for deadline control and documentation.
  • Good communication for interaction with clients and support for audits.
  • Teamwork and adaptability to different types of sensors and environments.

Desired

  • Experience in an accredited ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory.
  • Courses or certifications in the field of industrial instrumentation and metrology.
  • Knowledge in the calibration of other instruments (pressure, temperature, etc.).
  • Technical English skills


Responsabilidades


  • Executar calibração, testes funcionais e ajustes em detectores de gás portáteis e fixos.
  • Realizar procedimentos de ajuste de Zero e Span, utilizando gases padrões certificados e rastreáveis.
  • Lançar certificados de calibração conforme requisitos da ISO/IEC 17025 e normas regulatórias aplicáveis.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade metrológica dos resultados e manter registros completos dos serviços realizados.
  • Garantir a organização do laboratório e indicar melhorias no processo.
  • Seguir o método de calibração e procedimentos do laboratório.
  • Verificar periodicamente a validade e integridade dos padrões de referência.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e apoiar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Cumprir normas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente durante todo o processo de calibração


Requisitos


  • Formação técnica em Instrumentação, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em calibração e manutenção de detectores de gases.
  • Conhecimento de metrologia, rastreabilidade e avaliação de incerteza.
  • Familiaridade com normas ISO/IEC 17025 e procedimentos da Cgcre/Inmetro.
  • Habilidade para interpretar manuais técnicos e especificações de fabricantes.
  • Domínio em documentação técnica e emissão de certificados de calibração.

Habilidades

  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em precisão.
  • Organização para controle de prazos e documentação.
  • Boa comunicação, para interação com clientes e suporte a auditorias.

Desejado

  • Cursos ou certificações na área de instrumentação industrial e metrologia.
  • Conhecimento em calibração de outros instrumentos (pressão, temperatura, etc.).
  • Inglês técnico.

Regime de contratação : Pessoa Jurídica - PJ


PRESENCIAL

Principais Competências:


•⁠ ⁠Profissional com expertise no uso de ferramentas de monitoramento e proteção, com atuação direta em sistemas de prevenção e detecção de intrusão (IPS/IDS), firewalls de nova geração, soluções SIEM e antivírus corporativos, com uma postura preventiva e responsiva frente a incidentes.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidade técnica e estratégica para análise de vulnerabilidades, elaboração de planos de ação corretivos e preventivos, e coordenação de processos de resposta a incidentes de segurança, mantendo alinhamento com as diretrizes organizacionais e requisitos regulatórios.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal, facilitando a interação com áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Compliance, Jurídico e Auditoria Interna, contribuindo para a construção de uma cultura organizacional orientada à segurança.

•⁠ ⁠Será apresentado currículo prévio para aprovação em que o profissional demonstrará pelo menos um dos seguintes certificados: CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), CompTIA Security+, CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional). SERÁ NECESSÁRIA A COMPROVAÇÃO.


Atribuições Complementares:


•⁠ ⁠Investigação de incidentes complexos: analisar alertas e evidências digitais com técnicas avançadas de forensic e threat hunting.

•⁠ ⁠Resposta a incidentes: liderar ações imediatas para conter, erradicar e recuperar sistemas afetados por ataques cibernéticos.

•⁠ ⁠Análise de vulnerabilidades: conduzir avaliações profundas de segurança e recomendar soluções para falhas sistêmicas.

•⁠ ⁠Desenvolvimento de estratégias de defesa: criar políticas e planos para prevenir ataques e reduzir impactos.

KPIs e Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Taxa de conversão por dispositivo e canal.
  • Taxa de abandono de carrinho e checkout.

title: Project Analyst (Upstream)
description:
Project Analyst (Upstream)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: August 22, 2025

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?

If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

description:

JPA / Hibernate.

Criação e consumo de APIs REST.

Bootstrap.

Outros

Testes unitários e automatizados (JUnit, Mockito).

Conceitos de arquitetura de software (REST, Microservices).

Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI).

Segurança de aplicações (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP).

Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, microsserviços e integrações com serviços externos.

Garantir boas práticas de programação, versionamento e qualidade de código (Clean Code, SOLID).

Liderar revisões de código e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores.

Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de QA, infraestrutura e produto para entregar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

Identificar e propor melhorias de performance e segurança.

Perfil Esperado

Proatividade e capacidade de aprendizado contínuo.

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Visão crítica e foco em soluções escaláveis.

Autonomia para decisões técnicas e mentoria de colegas.



Formação

description:
Banco de Talentos - Profissionais da área Contábil e Fiscal – Gaspar/SC


Na Bunge, estamos continuamente aprimorando nossos esforços para garantir que nossa força de trabalho, programas e práticas estimulem uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Como uma empresa global com raízes profundas nas comunidades onde estamos presentes, nossos colaboradores representam uma ampla variedade de talentos e origens, essenciais para atender às necessidades em constante mudança de um mundo em crescimento. Norteados por nossos valores de:


  • Atuamos como um só time - promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscamos a excelência - sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazemos o que é certo - agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.


Estamos transformando nossa cultura, promovendo a colaboração e o respeito entre todos, de maneira ampla e abrangente.

Em nosso processo de inscrição, todas as candidaturas serão avaliadas ao longo de três meses. Os candidatos com perfil adequado às vagas disponíveis serão contatados para participar do processo seletivo. Ressaltamos que o contato não garante contratação. Independentemente do resultado, todos receberão um retorno sobre sua inscrição. Em caso de negativa, manteremos seu currículo em nosso banco de dados para futuras oportunidades. As etapas já realizadas poderão ser consideradas ou refeitas, dependendo dos requisitos da vaga.


Sobre a Bunge:


Presente em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 120 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos.


Sobre nosso centro de serviços compartilhados:


O Bunge Business Services (BBS) é a área de serviços compartilhados da Bunge que atua com conjunto com times de toda a empresa para fornecer globalmente serviços especializados. Com foco na melhoria contínua e no atendimento ao cliente, o BBS ajuda a agilizar e evoluir nossos processos para nos tornarmos mais ágeis, digitais e eficientes, possibilitando vantagens competitivas da Bunge no mercado. No Brasil, o BBS foi implantado em 2014 e atualmente está concentrado na cidade de Gaspar (SC), contando ainda com colaboradores alocados em diversas outras unidades da Bunge no Brasil. Atualmente, o BBS conta com um time multidisciplinar de cerca de 579 colaboradores, que têm como foco a migração e manutenção de serviços transacionais de todas as cadeias de valor da Bunge. A equipe também apoia a transformação digital da empresa por meio da adoção de tecnologias, análise de dados, automação e inovação, além de possuir uma atuação estratégica definida por indicadores de performance.

Este banco de talentos destina-se à captação de profissionais, com ou sem experiência, das áreas Contábil e Fiscal. A área Contábil é responsável por garantir que todos os processos contábeis e financeiros estejam de acordo com as normas vigentes. A área Fiscal, por sua vez, responsabiliza-se pelas atividades transacionais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias e a conformidade das operações com a legislação. Os currículos cadastrados serão considerados para oportunidades atuais e futuras, em diferentes posições.


Nossos benefícios:


  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;

  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório próprio;
  • *Transporte Fretado; (Gaspar, Blumenau, Ilhota, Balneário Camboriú e Itajaí)
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio creche (colaboradoras com filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • PLR - Participação nos lucros e resultados (Conforme atingimento de metas e resultados)
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Parcerias para desconto com TotalPass (academia), Clube MMB (Seguros individuais), Dell, Universidades e Escola de Idiomas;
  • Programa “Conte com a gente” (Assistência jurídica, social, psicológica e financeira para colaboradores e dependentes);
  • Incentivos de final de ano (Cesta de Natal e Brinquedos p/ filhos anualmente).

description:

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Educational Sales Advisor to be part of our growth journey.


Job Description


As an Educational Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for leading the full sales process while guiding clients through our educational and travel programs, ensuring an excellent customer experience every step of the way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sales Process Management: Lead the complete sales cycle using company-provided tools and software.
  • Product Advisory: Advise clients on educational and travel plans, including cross-selling, while meeting targets set by the Growth Management team.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure sales meet company quality standards (customer retention, minimal returns, accurate reporting of sales visits).
  • Prospecting: Continuously seek and develop new business prospects in line with company policies.
  • Customer Support: Direct client questions or concerns to the appropriate departments, ensuring high satisfaction levels.
  • Tool Management: Properly use company technology and documentation systems.
  • Additional Duties: Carry out other tasks as assigned by your supervisor or required by the role.

Requirements

  • High school diploma, technical degree, or bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, or related fields.
  • At least 2 years of experience in commercial roles, with knowledge of selling both services (intangibles) and products (tangibles).
  • Experience managing both in-person and remote sales channels.
  • Proficiency in office tools and CRM software for sales.
  • Ability to identify market opportunities and effectively manage sales pipelines.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a globally recognized educational services company.
  • Work 100% remotely with a dynamic, multicultural team.
  • Benefit from professional growth and development opportunities.

Remote Work Disclosure

Although this is a remote role, it requires exclusive dedication, discipline, and commitment.

  • If you are seeking to juggle multiple jobs simultaneously, this role is not suitable.
  • You must maintain a structured routine, high productivity, and strong communication.
  • A distraction-free home workspace is essential.

We’ve learned from past experience that remote collaboration only succeeds with self-discipline and full alignment with the company’s mission and values.

To succeed in this position, you will need:

  • A strict routine and strong self-management.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • A distraction-free workspace at home.

Workspace Requirements

  • Laptop or desktop with Windows 10 or higher.
  • Willingness to install MSQ security software and 2FA app on a mobile device.
  • Functional webcam.
  • Stable broadband internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • 8 GB RAM or more (dual monitors recommended).

Compensation

  • Monthly payment: R$ 2,211.67 (Brazilian reais).
  • Unlimited commissions.
  • Commitment of 40 hours per week on a rotating schedule, under an independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their resume and a cover letter highlighting their experience and qualifications

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.


Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.


Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.


Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal.


Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.


Como você poderá contribuir?

Atuar como Analista na gestão contratual, analisando pleitos de fornecedores sob aspectos técnicos e jurídicos, conduzindo negociações e assegurando cumprimento de normas e prazos. Contribuindo para a redução de riscos e custos. Apoia a gestão com relatórios, indicadores e suporte estratégico à tomada de decisão.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

O que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Back-End .
  • Vivência com Unity/C# e integração de sistemas.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs, estruturas de dados e algoritmos .
  • Experiência em controle de versionamento (GitHub) .

Com um forte foco em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Navigandi criou o Navigandi Orbis, a primeira Portable Pilot Unit (PPU) totalmente desenvolvida e fabricada nas Américas, e o Navigandi Tow, um sistema de navegação para empurradores e comboios fluviais. description:
Job Title: Logistics Innovation Senior Manager LATAM | Samsung Electronics


Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site


Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Description

The professional will play a transformative role in defining and deploying Samsung's Logistics Strategy for Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami) for Finished Goods (all product lines) and Spare Parts operations. Key programs to be carried out by this position include:

  • Long-Term Capacity Planning: Process Implementation and Improvement: Logistics Network Design, Warehouse Infrastructure (including automation projects), Transportation Modes, etc.
  • Cost Efficiency Program: Manage the project pipeline (PMO) and lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings (productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation, warehouse storage efficiency, lead time reductions, LSP management, etc.).
  • Process Innovation: Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that support logistics operations optimization and better governance in Latin America (planning, control, analysis).


Key Job Responsabilities


  • Collaborate on the definition and deployment Samsung’s logistics strategy for Latin America, covering Finished Goods and Spare Parts operations across key markets (Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami).
  • Implement and improve the “Long Term Capacity Planning” process, focusing on logistics network design, warehouse infrastructure (including automation projects), and transportation modes.
  • Manage the project pipeline (PMO) for the “Cost Efficiency Program.”
  • Lead analyses to identify new opportunities for operational efficiency improvements and cost savings, including:
  • Productivity increases for warehouse handling and transportation.
  • Warehouse storage efficiency enhancements.
  • Lead time reductions.
  • Strong collaboration with Procurement and other stakeholders.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset to create, redesign, and implement processes and tools that optimize logistics operations and improve governance in Latin America.
  • Focus on areas such as planning, control, and analysis to support logistics optimization.
  • Work closely with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to ensure seamless logistics operations across Latin America.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, IT, and other departments to drive efficiency and innovation.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate logistics performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Prepare detailed reports on logistics operations, cost-saving initiatives, and process innovations for senior management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to enhance logistics processes.
  • Lead initiatives to innovate and improve logistics strategies, ensuring adaptability to changing market conditions and customer demands.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to address concerns, implement solutions, and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to teams involved in logistics operations and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience in logistics, supply chain management, or related fields.
  • Experience in logistics operations and/or projects across Latin American countries (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Panama, Miami; not necessarily in all of them).
  • Experience in network design projects and logistics capacity planning.
  • Familiarity with logistics management software (WMS, TMS), ERP systems, and automation technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cost efficiency programs, including project pipeline management (PMO).
  • Expertise in identifying and implementing operational efficiency improvements and cost-saving initiatives.
  • Experience in applying process innovation to improve governance and operational performance.
  • Ability to prepare detailed analysis, graphics and reports to support and/or make presentations senior management.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams and drive strategic initiatives.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, internal and external partners.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI is a Plus.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory).
  • Spanish proficiency (mandatory).


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Make an Impact

title: Quality Assurance Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Job Summary:

Highridge Medical creates the world’s most innovative spinal solutions across the spectrum from Motion Preservation to MIS to Bone Healing to Core Spine. Working at Highridge Medical is not just work. Life at Highridge Medical is purpose driven. Every day, you have the privilege of using your talents to demonstrate Confidence in your work and restore Confidence for our patients. Confidence that moves.


The Regulatory and Quality Affairs Manager will oversee quality assurance and regulatory compliance for Highridge Medical’s operation in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring local alignment with global regulations and standards and for ensuring corporate alignment with Brazilian regulations and standards. This role will collaborate with cross-functional teams locally and globally to maintain product quality, manage regulatory submissions, and support market access.


Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure Compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements per ANVISA standards for product registration, licensing, and post-market Surveillance.
  • Prepare, submit, and manage regulatory dossiers for product approvals, renewals, and significant changes in Brazil.
  • Act as primary point of contact for Latin American distributors who are building dossiers to submit for approvals, renewals, and significant changes in their markets.
  • Monitor changes in Brazilian and Latin American regulations and advise on their impact to company operations.
  • Liase with ANVISA and other regulatory bodies as the primary point of contact, and Technical Responsible person, in Brazil.
  • Work with US based team members to develop global procedures that appropriately capture Brazilian requirements.
  • Advise local and corporate leadership on regulatory and quality strategies for market expansion in Brazil and other Latin American markets.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.


Quality Assurance:

  • Maintain and improve the local Quality Management System in accordance with Brazilian GMP and international standards.
  • Partner with corporate quality and regulatory teams to ensure global alignment of policies and procedures.
  • Conduct internal and external audits to ensure compliance with Quality Standards.
  • Manage Non-Conformances (NCs) and Corrective Action/Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to resolve quality issues for the Brazilian site.
  • Support global NCs and CAPAs to resolve quality issues which impact Brazil and Latin American markets.
  • Ensure proper documentation and record keeping for quality and regulatory processes both within the Brazilian site and at any 3rd party logistics providers in Brazil.
  • Implement Vigilance systems to track product performance on the Brazilian Market.
  • Organize and run Brazilian Management Review meetings.
  • Provide training to local staff on regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Host ANVISA for any audits that may need to take place at the Brazilian site.


Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills, and abilities)

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal); Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, international teams, company leadership, distributors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Working knowledge of global regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Ability to lead a team, influence others, and handle increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Understands the overall business environment, the orthopedic industry, and the marketplace. Direct experience with spinal implant companies is a plus.
  • Ability to identify and assess business risks to develop Regulatory strategy
  • Ability to manage/supervise employees and consultants.
  • Excellent project management and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills.

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (e.g. life sciences, engineering, pharmacy, or related discipline).
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • 6-8 years of experience required in a Regulatory and Quality Affairs capacity.
  • Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) preferred
  • Experience in the areas implantable medical device regulatory and quality affairs is strongly preferred.
  • A combination of education and experience may be considered

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15%

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Finance Supervisor to lead and support our financial operations in Brazil. Expense and Financial Management

Tax and Regulatory Compliance

Cross-functional and Global Collaboration

• Facilitate integration between global financial standards and local processes


Process Optimization

• Identify inefficiencies in financial workflows and propose improvements

• Strengthen internal controls to ensure compliance and operational integrity

• Drive adoption of new systems and tools to optimize financial operations


Qualifications

Essential

• Languages: Native Portuguese; fluent English (written and spoken)

• Experience: 3+ years in finance/accounting roles in Brazil

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUP)

• ERP proficiency (preferably SAP)

• Brazilian tax reporting tools (SPED, ECD/ECF)

• Strong understanding of Brazilian GAAP (CPC) and familiarity with IFRS

• Awareness of labor law implications on payroll and expense reporting

Preferred

  • • Industry Experience: Previous roles in multinational companies or electronics importers

title: Remote Physics Research Scientist (PhD) - 34878
description:
Turing is hiring Physics Research Scientists (PhD, Remote) to test and improve how advanced AI models handle reasoning and problem-solving in physics. Work with top AI labs, contribute to frontier benchmarks, and earn upto $150/hr on a flexible, remote schedule.


Role Overview:

We are seeking PhD-level Physics researchers to rigorously test the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). In this role, you’ll create physics problems, analyze model responses, and identify logical gaps to help improve AI’s conceptual understanding and structured problem-solving.


This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and evaluate challenging physics problems to test AI reasoning.
  • Analyze AI-generated solutions for logic, rigor, and step-by-step clarity.
  • Provide detailed, constructive feedback that highlights gaps in reasoning.
  • Contribute to the development of benchmarks that measure model performance on abstract and multi-step tasks.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine methodologies for testing AI reasoning.


Must-have Qualifications:

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or related fields.
  • Strong ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with structured reasoning.
  • Skilled communicator, able to explain logic and critique clearly in writing.
  • Independent, self-motivated, and comfortable in a remote setting.
  • Reliable computer and internet setup.


Why Join Turing?

  • Impact: Help define how AI models reason about abstract, scientific problems.
  • Prestige: Work with leading AI labs shaping the future of reasoning systems.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first, with weekly hour options.
  • Career Growth: Gain experience at the intersection of AI and physics research.


Contract & Selection Process:

  • Compensation: $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration: 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours: Up to 30 hrs/week.
  • Time Zone: 2–5 hrs/day overlap with UTC-8 (America/Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.


About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

title: Oliver Wyman - Talent Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our 7,000 professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman’s thought leadership is evident in our agenda-setting books, white papers, research reports, and articles in the business press. Our clients are the CEOs and executive teams of the top Global 1000 companies.


Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman:


Job Overview:


Oliver Wyman is seeking a Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.


The successful Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.


This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.


Key Responsibilities:


Talent Management:

  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training
  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor
  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice
  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations
  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed
  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives


Project Staffing:

  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled
  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area
  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed
  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly
  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner
  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks
  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals
  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW


Consultant Development and Performance Management:

  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations
  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants
  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager
  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations


Data, analysis and reporting:

  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured
  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports
  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results
  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed
  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems
  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date


Oliver Wyman Development:

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.
  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables
  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner
  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities
  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement


Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment
  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred


Skills and Attributes:

  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization
  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience
  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed
  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)
  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes
  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work
  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment
  • English and Spanish Speaker



Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.


Marsh McLennan is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Marsh McLennan is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh McLennan colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Resilience Engineer
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.



Ser protagonista na construção, evolução e sustentação da estratégia de resiliência tecnológica corporativa, com foco em arquiteturas robustas, redução de riscos operacionais, tolerância a falhas, e disponibilidade contínua de aplicações críticas.

Atuar como referência técnica para times de engenharia, arquitetura, sustentação e segurança, promovendo práticas estruturantes que elevem o nível de maturidade tecnológica da organização.



Nessa função você vai:


  • Desenvolver e sustentar diretrizes de arquitetura resiliente para ambientes on-premises, multi-cloud e híbridos;
  • Conduzir avaliações de maturidade de resiliência técnica (capability maturity model) e propor planos de evolução;
  • Apoiar times na definição de arquiteturas tolerantes a falhas, planos de continuidade e estratégias de recuperação automatizada;
  • Ser guardião técnico de práticas estruturantes de resiliência, como: Zonas de resiliência, Buffers e tolerâncias predefinidas e Arquitetura antifrágil;
  • Princípios de circuit breaker, backpressure, failover e retry com contexto;
  • Apoiar na construção de práticas e métricas de Resiliência aplicacional;
  • Participar ativamente de Post-mortem de eventos críticos, contribuindo com análise de impacto, causa raiz e planos de mitigação duradouros;
  • Estabelecer e monitorar indicadores de resiliência (SLOs, SLIs, SLI Error Budgets, MTTR, MTBF);
  • Apoiar simulações e testes estruturados de falhas de forma integrada;
  • Atuar como articulador entre arquitetura, operações e desenvolvimento para garantir que a resiliência esteja presente desde o design;
  • Realizar Assessment com Fornecedores de serviços críticos.



  • Arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e de missão crítica;
  • Ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e on-premises;
  • Containers (Kubernetes, Docker) e ferramentas de orquestração;
  • Automação com Terraform, Ansible, ou similares;
  • Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, New Relic, Datadog);
  • Protocolos e padrões de resiliência (circuit breaker, event sourcing, CQRS, retry policies);
  • Princípios de confiabilidade de sistemas (SRE, ITIL4 Resilience, Chaos Engineering).


Desejável :


Certificações: AWS Solutions Architect ou Azure Architect Expert, SRE Foundation (DevOps Institute) ou Google SRE Professional, CKA, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, ITIL4 Specialist - High Velocity IT (com foco em Resilience) e/ou Certified Chaos Engineering Practitioner (Gremlin).

title: Lead Analyst
description:
Are you a Lead analyst who is sought out for your strategic advice, not just your data skills? Do you want to move beyond reporting and directly shape the strategic direction of a growing business?


We are looking for a Lead Analyst to provide expert-level analytical leadership by working at our HQ in Dubai, UAE. . This role is for a seasoned professional who can manage complex, cross-functional workstreams, mentor a high-performing team, and translate raw data into compelling narratives for our executive leadership. You won't just provide data; you will provide the "so what" and "now what" that drives critical decisions.


If you're ready to own the strategic impact of analytics and influence at the CXO level, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do:

  • Drive Strategic Direction: Lead high-impact analytical workstreams across multiple products and business units, uncovering insights that shape our most important initiatives.
  • Influence Leadership: Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable strategic recommendations and present them compellingly to senior and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Mentor and Elevate: Guide and mentor junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical excellence, curiosity, and rigorous best practices across the team.
  • Champion Data-Driven Decisions: Partner directly with business leaders to identify opportunities, quantify risks, and establish metrics that define success.


Who You Are (Qualifications):

  • You have 6+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.g., Business Analyst, Data Science, Strategy) within a top-tier consulting firm, tech company, or product-led organization.
  • You possess expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker). Experience with AI/ML modeling is a significant plus.
  • You are a master of data storytelling —you can build a narrative, craft a compelling presentation, and confidently defend your recommendations to senior audiences.
  • You have proven leadership and mentoring capabilities , with a passion for elevating the skills of those around you.
  • You have an ownership mindset : you thrive in ambiguity, are relentlessly resourceful, and hold yourself accountable for driving tangible business outcomes.


Why Join Us?

  • Executive Impact: Your analysis will directly inform decisions at the highest levels of the company.
  • Leadership Opportunity: Step into a player-coach role where you can shape both strategy and team culture.
  • Complex Challenges: Tackle the most ambiguous and strategic business problems we face.


About Us-


Landmark Group


Our journey started in 1973 with a single store in Bahrain. Since then, we have grown into a global retail and hospitality group. The proud creator of 25 plus value led, own-built brands across retail, hospitality, food, and leisure.


Over the years, our UAE - based group has evolved into a comprehensive retail and hospitality entity, with over 2200 retail stores, leisure, and hospitality outlets, panning the GCC, Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, and Africa. Today, Landmark Group is one of GCC's largest omnichannel retailers and India's top home and fashion retailer.


We take immense pride in the organic growth of our retail brands, which have blossomed into household names. From Max, Splash, Babyshop, Centrepoint, Shoemart, Home Centre, Emax, Fitness First, to Fun City, to name a few, our brands span across a multitude of categories, enriching the lives of countless families over the past decade.


As a part of the Landmark Group, a renowned retail and hospitality conglomerate in the Middle East, North Africa, and India, Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy.


Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%.


Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers.


Landmark Digital


At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture , empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products.


Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies , including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.


In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits , we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally.


Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Cozinheiro
description:
• Cozinheiro(a) Líder — Cozinha Industrial Escolar (produção em grande volume).


Você é apaixonado(a) por cozinha de alto volume, capricho visual e quer impactar positivamente a alimentação de crianças? Estamos buscando um(a) Cozinheiro(a) Líder para atuar na nossa cozinha industrial, com foco em produção diária de refeições para escolas, garantindo sabor, nutrição e apresentação impecável nas cubas/GN’s.


Modelo de contratação e benefícios

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Jornada: segunda a sexta, das 6h às 15h.
  • Local: Rua Coronel Diogo - Aclimação - São Paulo/SP
  • Remuneração: R$3.100,00 nos 3 primeiros meses e após o período de experiência, R$3.400,00 + R$290 de cesta básica, plano de saúde opcional com co-participação, PLR semestral com teto de R$500/semestre. Férias coletivas entre os dias 20/12 e 02/01
  • Início: Imediato


Responsabilidades

Liderar e organizar a rotina de uma equipe de 3 pessoas (1 cozinheiro e 2 ajudantes), com delegação clara, acompanhamento e feedbacks

Atuar “mão na massa” : pré-preparo, cocção, finalização e montagem de cubas/GN’s com ótima apresentação visual para o serviço;

Planejar e executar produção de grandes volumes, seguindo cronograma, fichas técnicas e porcionamento padronizado;

Montar linha quente com visual atrativo para o público infantil, assegurando padronização e apelo visual;

Garantir qualidade e segurança dos alimentos, incluindo:

  • Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF);
  • Controle de tempo e temperatura, manutenção a quente e frio;
  • Higienização correta de hortifrutis;
  • Prevenção de contaminação cruzada (inclusive com alergênicos);
  • Registro de controles (checklists, temperaturas, amostras);

Operar equipamentos industriais (como forno combinado, panelas de pressão de 25 e 35 litros, processadores e batedeiras industriais) e zelar pela limpeza e conservação;

Auxiliar na conferência, recebimento e armazenamento (FIFO/FEFO), organizar câmaras fria e estoque, reduzir perdas e desperdícios;

Trabalhar em parceria com a Nutrição: executar cardápio, ajustar preparos, calibrar rendimentos e apresentar melhorias;

Preparar e conferir o embarque (hotboxes), rotulagem e identificação dos itens, assegurando integridade até a escola;

Treinar a equipe em técnicas, segurança alimentar, organização e ritmo de produção;


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em cozinha industrial/coletiva, com produção de grande volume;
  • Vivência prática na montagem de cubas/GN’s com excelente apresentação;
  • Conhecimento sólido em BPF e segurança de alimentos (controle de tempo/temperatura, higienização, limpeza e sanitização);
  • Organização, agilidade e atenção a detalhes;
  • Perfil de liderança: sabe delegar, orientar e manter o clima de equipe positivo;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em rotina dinâmica, com horários de início cedo;
  • Comprometimento com padrões para alimentação infantil.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em alimentação escolar, UAN ou empresas de refeições coletivas;
  • Domínio de forno combinado e equipamentos industriais;
  • Familiaridade com RDCs da ANVISA relacionadas a BPF e padrões microbiológicos.


Formação

  • Desejável curso técnico em Gastronomia, Cozinha ou similar (não eliminatório);
  • Certificações em BPF/Segurança dos Alimentos são um plus.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. This position is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented individual looking to grow their career in finance. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.


Key Job Responsibilities:

1. Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.

2. Account Reconciliation:

  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

3. Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.

4. Financial Reporting:

  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

5. Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

6. Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.


Qualifications:


  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

title: Tax Intern
description:

【About JD.com】

JD.com (NASDAQ: JD; HKEX: 9618), also known as JINGDONG (ranks 44 on 2025 Fortune Global 500), has evolved from a pioneering e-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, the company has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting-edge digital solutions.Learn more about us:


【About JD Industrials】

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.


Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs.


Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America.

Why Join Us：
